description: Legacy completion sites in the JS/TS rows of openai-dev-30 and anthropic-dev-30, with what refit deadlines --propose-model-fixes --parameter-changes data/model-parameter-changes.json does on the branch that adds pipeline/legacy-completions.ts. Dev sets only; no measurement set was opened.

sites.shape: completions.create, gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, prompt const template, max_tokens, temperature 0.8; reads choices[0].text
sites.reason: temperature on gpt-5.6-terra (existing parameter rule; no OpenAI page states support)
sites.verdict: correct stop: the call and read shapes map; only temperature holds it

sites.shape: completions.create, text-davinci-003; reads response.choices.length then choices[0].text
sites.verdict: correct stop (the choices.length read would stop it too)

sites.shape: stream: true, prompt from req.json(), stream handed to OpenAIStream
sites.verdict: correct stop (the untyped prompt and the OpenAIStream consumer would stop it too)

sites.shape: stream: true, const string prompt, stream handed to OpenAIStream
sites.verdict: correct stop (the OpenAIStream consumer would stop it too)

sites.shape: v3 createCompletion, text-davinci-003; returns res.data.choices whole
sites.reason: v3-style client has no Responses API

sites.shape: completions.create, model 'claude-2', `Human: ${prompt}\n\nAssistant:`, stop_sequences, reads completion.completion twice
sites.reason: 'claude-2' (the bare alias) is not in the registry, which lists claude-2.0 and claude-2.1 from Anthropic's deprecations page, so the model-fix rule never sees the call
sites.verdict: follow-up: registry alias coverage (the same shape with claude-2.1 is rewritten in the synthetic fixtures)

sites.shape: completions.create with a model variable and a temperature variable
sites.reason: the model is not a retired literal the rule traces; 0.5.10 would stop anyway (before 0.14.0)
